metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean sampled real-item pair cosine mapped to [0,1]; excludes PAD/MASK. Measures angular similarity, not recommendation diversity. Null when fewer than two embeddings can be sampled.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit on real-label supervised positions containing reserved MASK; training separation, not validation performance. Null if no valid positions.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of audited supervised training margins; null if unavailable.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of audited masked positions with negative logit greater than positive logit.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of audited masked positions with margin below 0.5.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts and mask audit for up to ten training batches. Original-label/corruption provenance is unavailable; equality alone cannot establish leakage. Category lists remain empty because categories are unavailable.

recent_history_probe.source: One independently trained category checkpoint. Up to 200 seed-42 sampled eligible training users after catalog-ID validation and length filtering. Target is the final training event; prefix is its strictly earlier last L-1 events. Earlier target repeats remain valid. Training-exposed recovery only; no host validation claim.
recent_history_probe.candidates: Target once plus up to 99 unique uniform negatives excluding the entire supplied training history. Small eligible pools use all available items and report actual counts. Candidate arrays and order are frozen before donor draws and reused across interventions. These auxiliary candidates do not change the host benchmark.
recent_history_probe.matching: Occurrence frequency counts all valid supplied training events including repeats. Bin 0 is f=0; positive frequency bin b=1+floor(log2(f)) has [2^(b-1),2^b). Catalog IDs and donor pools are sorted. Each original occurrence is replaced uniformly from its bin excluding the full user history and every candidate. Draws use replacement across occurrences and ten paired replicates; repeats may be introduced. Empty pools are never widened. No additional plausibility or repeat-multiplicity matching is performed.
recent_history_probe.inference: Reserved appended MASK, unchanged absolute slots and padding, greatest nonpadding absolute readout, one module in evaluation mode without gradients. Live identity-copy scores require rtol=1.3e-6 and atol=1e-5; failed or nonfinite user fixtures are excluded and recorded. Live parity does not certify fresh-process predictor/checkpoint parity, which remains unavailable.
recent_history_probe.interventions: Disjoint oldest and newest blocks have k=min(3,floor(n/2)). Ten paired identity-substitution replicates preserve length, visibility, padding and final MASK. Swap exchanges the two blocks preserving internal order, middle tokens and exact item multiset. Four branches report recent-baseline, older-baseline, recent-older and swap-baseline on common matchable users. All-eligible swap effects are separately descriptive. No-op swaps remain included.
recent_history_probe.outcomes: Target score, target-minus-hardest-negative margin, one-based stable candidate-order target rank and descriptive HR10=rank<=10. Margin is null with no negatives. Top10 overlap is intersection/minimum returned list length; empty lists make it undefined. Temporal inversion fields are unavailable for this specification, not evidence of chronological health.
recent_history_probe.aggregation: Average the ten replicates within each user then weight users equally. Recent-older subtracts paired older effects from recent effects. Positive rank delta means worse recovery; positive margin or HR delta means improved recovery. Effective-edit summaries are separately descriptive. No matching multiplicity weights are applied.
recent_history_probe.uncertainty: 20000 seed-42 paired-user bootstrap resamples share indices across contrasts within category, conditional on fitted checkpoint, selected users, fixed candidates and realized donors. Ordinary percentile 95% intervals are exploratory. Bonferroni percentile tails are 0.05/(2*48) and 1-0.05/(2*48), retaining the planned four contrasts x three outcomes x four categories denominator. Approximate coverage; empirical tail resolution is 1/20000, about 10.4 draws per extreme tail. Target scores, overlap and strata are descriptive and outside the inferential family. Undefined outcomes report null and counts.
recent_history_probe.donor_monte_carlo: For each paired replicate compute its equal-user category mean; report across-ten-replicate sample SD/sqrt(10) separately from user intervals. Ten draws give limited precision. This concerns donor sampling conditional on users and candidates and is not added to bootstrap intervals. Donor concentration and 1/sum(p_d^2) are draw-diversity summaries, not independent-user sample sizes.
recent_history_probe.support_balance: Per-position pool sizes, attempted/matched users and replicates, empty-pool reasons, candidate counts and complete assignments are recorded. Rejection fraction includes fixture failures. Retained versus excluded sampled users are compared by full history length, target training frequency and retained-prefix repeat status. Quartile cutpoints come from all sampled support rows; ties use searchsorted side=right. Balance uses occurrence-weighted raw/log1p means, donor-minus-original differences, maximum empirical-CDF discrepancy and standardized differences using sqrt((var_original+var_donor)/2); zero variance makes standardized differences null. Coarse balance does not imply contextual plausibility, exchangeability or absence of selection bias.
recent_history_probe.provenance: Trial-local diagnostic_artifacts JSON records category, catalog order, occurrence counts, exact bin edges and sizes, fixed candidates, per-user seeds, per-token donor pools sizes, assignments in draw order, effects and failures. No model architecture, training objective, predictor writer or checkpoint configuration changes. No extra fitted scorer or score fusion.
recent_history_probe.limitations: Substitution damage mixes content and context disruption; swaps mix arrangement, local context and item-position associations. Neither identifies causal recency, preferences or utility. Position-offset and fresh-process parity hooks remain unavailable. Results do not generalize automatically beyond matchable users. No unavailable reviews, ratings, item categories, commercial attributes or simulator traits are used.
recent_history_probe.availability_budget: Only host-supported four-category macro validation HR10 selects revisions. No validation diagnostic protocol or reload runner is supplied here. No candidate sensitivity seeds or adaptive bin selection are added. This bounded diagnostic specification uses ten loader batches and at most 200 users/category. All execution consumes the shared search budget. Module modes, global RNGs and discovered loader generators are restored; iterator progress and worker-local RNGs cannot generally be restored. Supply a disposable diagnostic loader without persistent workers. Training, four-category routing, full-catalog simulator recommendations and one checkpoint/category remain unchanged.
